_meta.note: Source registry for the research/dossier tools: 900 sources from the owner's curated lists, classified by best FREE programmatic access. Tiers: api_keyless > searxng_enabled > searxng_available > api_key > fetch_pattern > bulk_download > paid_only. reliability is an Admiralty source-axis PRIOR (A authoritative primary/official, B established secondary, C aggregator, F cannot judge); the vetting stage grades claims independently. paid_only entries are kept ON PURPOSE so the tool can brief the user that the definitive source exists behind a subscription, instead of pretending it does not. 1.0.1: ReliefWeb reclassified api_key (v2 appname requirement) and GDELT throttle noted, both from live measurement.
